purpose: Verify that an independently explained, stable parallel line family remains a review grouping rather than being repainted as a geometric anomaly.

implementation.protection: A competing parallel family with at least half of its member lines already explained by an independent stable global or local family is not emitted as a conflict candidate.

paired_natural_mutation_benchmark.interpretation: The known injected-line localization result did not decrease, while review-candidate noise on clean paired photographs decreased. This is not AI-origin accuracy.

input.generation_intent: A normal, complex, physically plausible busy railway-station photograph with people, train, roof trusses, cables, reflections and ordinary clutter; no deliberate geometric conflict.

metadata-free_generated_scene_smoke.interpretation: A normally composed AI image can have stable, mutually coherent projected line families. P0 correctly no longer calls those families anomalous; P0 is therefore not used as source evidence. Independent pixel signals detected this particular image without metadata.

limitations: One generated scene is a smoke test, not an estimate of source-detection accuracy or a replacement for a generator-isolated benchmark.
The natural-mutation benchmark measures localization of deliberate line edits on real photographs, not the prevalence of geometric errors in either camera or generated images.
No P0 output contributes to the current AI-origin decision.
